notes: The gloss - أملاه علينا - is left out.
وعن رجل، آخر هو أفضل في نفسي من عبد الرحمن عن أبي بكرة names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4). The compiler's own comparison is not read as a route.
In the main route the Companion is the bare relation أبيه; the text does not name him here.
